cohort: 294 infants (80 born to mothers with IBD and 214 to mothers without IBD)
finding: Maternal IBD diagnosis influences microbiota in their offspring during early life, and the proteomic profile of breast milk in women with IBD differs from that of women without IBD, showing distinct time-dependent associations with baby's gut microbiome and fecal calprotectin.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a major influencer of the overall composition of the microbiota.
